lessons: A contracts step can let three workers run at once when every hook has its own translation unit and test file and the composing file only calls them; a hook that must be a no-op keeps the original expression textually (a re-associated sum is identical only by luck), and the parity check on every judging window is the proof.

A contract that reads the mask beyond a block states its reach against the margin formula of the land-share rule, and a contract that incises or lifts by a rate times a time states the time bound within which its physical argument holds.
